title: RainRunner
description: Speed boost while it is raining.
body:
# RainRunner

Speed boost while it is raining.

## Features
- Applies SPEED under RAIN condition.
- Configurable intervals and amplifier.
- Permission-based access.
- Lightweight scheduled checks.

## Command
- `/rainrunner status | /rainrunner reload`

## Permissions
- `rainrunner.use`
- `rainrunner.admin`

## Config (snippet)
```yml
effect: "SPEED"
condition:
  type: "RAIN"
```

## Compatibility
- Server: Paper, Spigot, Purpur
- Minecraft: 1.16.5 - 1.21.4

## Install
1. Drop the jar into `plugins/`.
2. Restart the server.
3. Edit `config.yml` and run the reload command.
